sloka: कृत्येषु वाली मेधावी राजानो बहु दर्शनः ।भवन्ति पर हन्तारः ते ज्ञेयाः प्राकृतैः नरैः ॥४-२-२३॥
transliteration: kṛtyeṣu vālī medhāvī rājāno bahu darśanaḥ ।bhavanti para hantāraḥ te jñeyāḥ prākṛtaiḥ naraiḥ ॥4-2-23॥

translations.english: 'Vali is wise in his actions. Kings employ many strategies to annihilate their enemies. Our gullible individuals should be able to detect them.
